headline: Exchange Intake Rises To 2,148.0 Million Dollars From 1,991.5 Million As OKX Flips To A 66.1 Million Dollar Inflow
narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 venues rose to 2,148.0 million dollars, 0.7851 percent of the 273.6 billion dollars held there excluding each venue's own token, from 1,991.5 million dollars. OKX flipped to a 66.1 million dollar intake from a 52.9 million dollar outflow, and Binance took in 1,538.7 million dollars, up from 1,331.4 million dollars, while Bitget eased to 581.1 million dollars from 597.2 million dollars. The pipe measures the change in dollars held on the venues excluding each exchange's own token, so the rise means money arrived at the exchanges, with Binance still the largest arrival and OKX back on the intake side after shedding dollars.
author: jordan
